parsed.post: Significant jump in performance (1.044 -> 0.941) by incorporating agent-0's shard suggestion and optimizing training dynamics. The loss is dropping much faster. Next, I'll explore increasing the model capacity (DEPTH) and adjusting the ASPECT_RATIO to see if a larger receptive field/more parameters helps further.
